description: The host that owns top-level routing, loading, layout and error isolation, and mounts micro-frontends into slots.
A framework-agnostic API such as `mount(element, props)` returning `unmount`, so the shell never depends on a team's framework.
Loading independently deployed bundles in the browser and mounting them on demand, as single-spa and Module Federation do.
Assembling HTML fragments from several teams on the server or at the edge (SSI, ESI) before the page reaches the browser.
Catching a micro-frontend's load or mount failure and rendering a fallback in its slot while the rest of the page keeps working.
Named browser events with a documented `detail` payload (`mfe:navigate`) used for loose communication between micro-frontends and the shell.
